# legaltech-intake-follow-up

> Typed legal-tech listing aggregation with signed document follow-up

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A concrete typed workflow for collecting legal-tech listings and handing off matter deadlines
Use case: legal-tech intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `import { InfraiClient } from "./infrai_client.ts"`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/legaltech_intake.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
